task.title: L12 manifest isolated restart proof workstream

scope.owned_layer: Isolated, non-shared daemon restart proof for one required L12 worker image.

acceptance.statement: isolated worker restart proof shows RestartCount increment or waiver exists
proof distinguishes daemon restart from operator restart
acceptance.note: The operator injects a process-level SIGKILL into the isolated PID 1. Docker receives no stop/kill request, and no start/up command follows; RestartCount increments while the same container ID returns with a new PID.

acceptance.statement: shared dev stack is not destructively tested
output is integrable by L12-MANIFEST-001 owner

review.exact_task_pr_head_note: The head that actually merged to dev, via PR #4338. Earlier manifest revisions cited 1656574ca (PR #4334's head), which was the first reviewed head, not the delivered one.

reviewed_head_chain.note: Delta re-review of the manifest-only change on top of #4334.

Owner refresh of the approved branch onto current dev. Carries no evidence-directory change: all six blobs are byte-identical to approved head 801852aeb (README.md 5fccbc867, evidence.json 9e88dd52c, evidence.sha256 5da5cf07a, fixture.compose.yml 1c2020122, proof-run.json 6c407410e, run-proof.sh f5a01ea21).

required_checks: re-run or inspect the isolated proof
confirm RestartCount increments on the same container ID
confirm the shared pantheon worker snapshot is unchanged
confirm cleanup removes only the isolated project
review.note: Claude2 independently re-ran run-proof.sh under isolated project l12-restart-proof-review-claude2 at PR #4334 exact head 1656574ca9314f93a02af0a34b56ed2ac966ee7a. The evidence directory was byte-identical to reviewed anchor afac18b8f; the merge commit only incorporated unrelated dev files. The same isolated container restarted after host-namespace PID 1 SIGKILL with PID 180354 -> 183080 and RestartCount 0 -> 1. No Docker stop/kill API was used, no start/up command followed the signal, the shared pantheon worker snapshot stayed unchanged, cleanup left zero isolated containers and networks, checksum verification passed, and the done guardrail dry-run reported no gaps.

unstrand.why: PR #4338 merged at 2026-07-29T03:38:04Z before the bound reviewer verdict landed on the canonical row, stranding the row at status 'review'. approve fails closed on a non-open PR; command_blocker and command_restore_approved are owner-only (and the latter also requires status=in_progress), so the reviewer had no canonical channel to move or even flag the row. Eight re-dispatches confirmed the deadlock without changing it.

canonical_row_at_unstrand.note: Owner and reviewer were rotated by the Wave 0 dispatch. The delivery-time owner/reviewer recorded in this manifest's task and review blocks are Codex and Claude2 and are unchanged.

deliverable_integrity_recheck.method: git archive origin/dev of the evidence directory, then git hash-object and sha256sum -c

residual_nits_repaired: task.owner read 'Codex2' (a worker identity) where the canonical delivery owner was 'Codex'; the worker identity is now recorded separately in task.delivery_worker_identity.

review.exact_task_pr_head cited 1656574ca, the first reviewed head from PR #4334, rather than 69e36e76da0cc41aff7a6faf765bc38e0efca985, the head that actually merged to dev; the full reviewed head chain is now recorded.
review.canonical_review_status_id was pinned to the PR #4334 status 51264813501; it now matches the canonical row's github_review_bridge.status_id 51265159718 for approved head 801852aeb.
unstrand.process_gap_for_upstream: Once a task PR merges ahead of the bound reviewer verdict, approve, reviewer-side reopen and reviewer-side blocker are all unavailable, and the reviewer cannot clear the pending handoff that keeps re-triggering dispatch. Suggested fix: let the review bridge accept a MERGED PR whose head matches the reviewed head for approve and reopen, or allow the reviewer to file a blocker.
